data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word sophos, meaning 'wise'. In Greek mythology, Sophea was the personification of wisdom. The name Sophey carries the meaning “Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sophey usually hope their child will grow to embody wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sophey total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
data.cultural_impact: In Christian culture, the name Sophey is traditionally associated with wisdom, learning, and intellect, making it an ideal name for a girl deemed intelligent or scholarly within her community. It may also be given to signify the desire for a child to possess these qualities and grow up to be wise and knowledgeable individuals.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the name Sophey serves as a reminder of God's wisdom and divine guidance in our lives. By bearing this name, one can be inspired to seek knowledge, understanding, and truth from God, and to apply that knowledge in a manner that glorifies and serves Him. Additionally, it may serve as an encouragement for those who bear the name to strive to develop wisdom through their experiences and their relationship with God.
